description: Representative Steven Ultrino’s bill to prohibit discrimination of natural and protective hairstyles has successfully been signed by the GovernorBOSTON – After the State Legislature enacted H.4554, An Act prohibiting discrimination based on natural and protective hairstyles – better known as Massachusetts’ version of The CROWN Act last Monday, Governor Baker has signed the legislation into law.
